about: Touched-path to test-suite map, read by `botq test-map`. First matching rule wins. `tests: []` means consciously untested and carries its why. Commands run from the repo root.

rules.why: GitHub is the only runner; the push that lands a workflow is the run that checks it
a parse catches syntax; the web build inside the shell catches a missing tool
the browser front end compiles only for wasm32; the web build also checks the wasm-bindgen pin
segmentation, collision and sprite logic are native tests; the wasm clippy covers the browser code
